top.text: Today's the NIST AI agent identity comment deadline. 6+ IETF drafts. Dozens of enterprise frameworks. Hundreds of RSAC booths. Zero shipped cross-ecosystem agent identity standard. Meanwhile: wallet signature → verified agent email → done. Standards validate the problem.
top.translationZh: 今天是 NIST AI 智能体身份识别标准的征求意见截止日。6+ 个 IETF 草案，几十个企业框架，几百个 RSAC 展位，结果跨生态系统的智能体身份标准一个都没落地。与此同时：钱包签名 → 验证智能体邮箱 → 搞定。标准的存在本身就证明了问题的复杂性。

top.author: @ModernCSA
top.text: AI pulls from the same sources as Google. Ai is not a historical repository. It is a tool to help you write an email or help you check in for your flight. If you believe AI is more accurate than primary sources, you need to reevaluate your life
top.translationZh: AI从和Google一样的来源获取信息，它不是什么历史档案馆。AI就是个帮你写邮件、帮你网上值机的工具。如果你觉得AI比第一手资料还准确，那你真该好好反思一下自己的人生了
